summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return (Hong Kong equivalent of an issuer share buyback report) on May 7, 2026, detailing share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange between March 20 and April 13, 2026. A total of 17 buyback trades were reported, each for cancellation, at prices ranging from approximately USD 6.5654 to USD 6.8164 per Class A ordinary share. The total number of shares repurchased but not yet cancelled was approximately 11.6 million shares, representing about 1.38% of existing issued shares. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing updates total issued shares unchanged at 840,422,467. Watch for ongoing buyback cadence and potential cancellation impact on floating supply.
